forest-bathing.name: forest-bathing
notes: Original fully clothed person pauses in a small wooded setting. Equal fixed leg lengths and shoes meet the ground plane; a short neck joins the head and shirt, with thinner arms than thighs. Side and top views establish separation from two rooted trees. This is a sensory-pause emblem, not a bathing or yoga pose, a specific forest route, or a medical treatment claim.
